summary: Frontend-only testing of Courier /courier DELIVERY TAB overhaul. All 13 scenarios from review_request validated end-to-end via Playwright. Split sections (Menunggu di Outlet + Di Atas Motor), scan-motor-button flow, StrictMode-safe single-scan behavior, 2-step PoD modal (delivery + payment for bayar-nanti), sequential capture gating, cancel, empty states, pickup tab regression, and navigation to /, /production, /admin all work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: CourierDashboard.jsx is 893 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider extracting the PoD modal, Scanner modal, and section renderers into sub-components for maintainability.

handleScanMotorLoad uses queueMicrotask inside a setState updater to avoid StrictMode double-invoke side effects - works correctly in tests but is an unusual pattern; a flushSync + useEffect-based approach may be more idiomatic.
Toast description in handleScanPickup uses `manifest.length + 1` which references stale closure state; may show incorrect total if multiple scans queued rapidly (minor UX).
seed_data_creation: None - all mock data is client-side initial state
context_for_next_testing_agent: All /courier delivery overhaul behaviors verified. Initial state: 4 ready (LND-005/006/007/008), 1 motor (LND-004). Scanner modal reused with scanMode state. StrictMode double-call handled via queueMicrotask + idempotent check. PoD sequential flow: capture-delivery enables capture-payment (only for paymentStatus='nanti'); both required before confirm. Cancel keeps order on motor. Pickup tab, manifest, angkut-semua, and / /production /admin routes all unaffected.
